account.entitlement_exceeded: The salon's plan has no free staff seat. Remove a staff member or ask the platform to move the salon to a larger plan.

console.title: Operator console
console.signInHelp: Sign in with your operator account. Every operator completes two-step verification.
console.mfaEnrollHelp: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
console.mfaVerifyHelp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
console.mfaNotice: This setup key is shown only now. Do not share it, and do not save it anywhere except your authenticator app.
console.denied: Your operator account cannot use this section. Sign out, or ask an administrator for access.
console.signedOut: Your console session has ended. Sign in again.
console.searchSalonsHelp: Search by salon name or web address.
console.searchPlansHelp: Search by plan name or key.
console.planSearchHelp: Newest plans are listed first. Search by plan name or key to find any other.
console.total: {total, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
console.salonsEmptyHelp: Create the first salon with its Owner and plan.
console.plansEmptyHelp: Define a plan before you create a salon.
console.slugHelp: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The salon is reached at {example}.
console.countryHelp: Two-letter ISO code, for example LK.
console.currencyHelp: Three-letter ISO code, for example LKR.
console.timeZoneHelp: An IANA time zone, for example Asia/Colombo.
console.contactPhoneHelp: A Sri Lankan mobile number, for example 077 123 4567.
console.noPlansToChoose: Create a plan first; a salon needs one.
console.ownerPasswordHelp: 15 to 128 characters. Share it with the Owner privately; it is never shown again.
console.ownerNext: Next: the Owner signs in at {url} with the initial password and sets up two-step verification.
console.planKeyHelp: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot change later.
console.immutable: A plan never changes after it is created. Define a new plan for different limits.
console.detailsUnavailable: This record could not be found.
console.uncertain: The console could not confirm whether this was saved. Try again: the same request is sent, so nothing is created twice.
console.service_unavailable: The console cannot reach the service right now. Try again in a moment.
console.invalid_credentials: The email, password or code was not accepted.
console.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
console.invalid_session: Your console session has ended. Sign in again.
console.permission_denied: Your operator account cannot do this.
console.not_found: This record could not be found.
console.slug_taken: Another salon already uses this web address.
console.plan_key_taken: Another plan already uses this key.
console.idempotency_conflict: This request was already used for different details. Review and submit again.
console.request_rejected: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
console.browser_unsupported: This browser cannot keep console sessions safe across tabs. Use a current browser to sign in or out.
console.noBillingContact: No billing contact: this salon has no Owner email, so reminders are recorded but no email is sent.
console.noSubscriptionHelp: This salon is not billed yet and works normally. Starting a subscription begins a 14-day trial.
console.subscriptionStarted: Subscription started. The 14-day trial has begun.
console.subscriptionChanged: Billing changed. A new amount applies from the next invoice.
console.planMoved: Plan changed. The next invoice carries the new plan.
console.monthlyAmountHelp: Up to two decimals, for example 2500 or 2500.50. A change applies from the next invoice.
console.monthlyAmountCreateHelp: Up to two decimals, for example 2500. The salon starts with a 14-day trial; the first invoice is issued when it ends.
console.startSubscriptionHelp: The salon is billed monthly after a 14-day trial.
console.subscriptionCurrencyHelp: This salon has no currency of its own; the subscription is billed in this one. Three-letter ISO code.
console.changeBillingHelp: Issued invoices keep their amount; a new amount applies from the next invoice.
console.movePlanHelp: Current plan: {plan}. The next invoice carries the new plan.
console.movePlanExceeded: The salon uses more than the new plan allows. Remove staff first or choose a larger plan.
console.noOtherPlans: There is no other plan to move to.
console.invoicesEmptyHelp: The first invoice is issued when the trial ends.
console.recordTransferHelp: Invoice {number} for {amount}. Record the bank transfer that paid it in full.
console.transferReferenceHelp: The reference on the bank transfer, up to 120 characters.
console.transferAmountHelp: The exact amount of the invoice; a partial or larger amount is refused.
console.transferReceivedOnHelp: The date the transfer arrived; not a future date.
console.entitlement_exceeded: The salon uses more than this plan allows.
console.invalid_state: This is no longer possible: the record changed. Reload to see it.
console.conflict: Someone changed this salon meanwhile. Reload and try again.
console.suspendedHelp: This salon is suspended: its staff see “temporarily unavailable”, its messages wait and its jobs are skipped. Billing goes on.
console.closedHelp: This salon is closed and cannot be reopened. Its data and export are deleted on {date}.
console.deletedHelp: This salon's data was deleted on {date}. Its invoices, payments and history are kept.
console.closedNotice: The salon is closed. Its export is being prepared.
console.suspendHelp: Staff and customers are refused until it is reactivated; their sessions are kept. Invoices are still issued.
console.reactivateHelp: The salon opens again with the access its billing allows, read-only if an invoice is 14 or more days overdue.
console.reasonHelp: 10 to 500 characters. Kept in the salon's history and the platform audit.
console.closeSalonHelp: Closing is permanent. Read what happens, then type the web address to confirm.
console.closeConsequenceHost: {hostname} stops working at once, as if the salon never existed.
console.closeConsequenceSessions: Every staff and customer session ends and waiting messages are cancelled.
console.closeConsequenceBilling: Billing stops: no new invoice is issued; open invoices stay as records.
console.closeConsequenceExport: The Owner contact is emailed a download link to a full export of the salon's data.
console.closeConsequenceDeletion: All of the salon's data and its export are deleted for good 30 days after closure, on {date}.
console.closeConsequenceSlug: The web address “{slug}” is retired and can never be used again.
console.confirmSlugHelp: The web address exactly as shown, in lower case.
console.historyEmptyHelp: Suspensions, reactivations, closure and deletion appear here with their reasons.
console.exportDownloaded: The export was downloaded. Compare its SHA-256 checksum with the one shown here.
console.exportPendingHelp: The export is being prepared. It is usually ready within a minute; refresh to check.
console.exportDeletedHelp: The export was deleted with the salon's data.
console.supportHelp: Read this salon's workspace as its Owner sees it, without its password. The session is time-limited, recorded with your reason and visible to the salon's Owner.
console.supportUnavailable: Support sessions can be started only for an active salon.
console.supportStartHelp: Your reason is shown to the salon's Owner and kept in the audit logs. The workspace is read only.
console.supportReasonHelp: 10 to 500 characters, for example the ticket and what the Owner asked for.
console.supportDurationHelp: The session ends by itself after this time.
console.supportReadyHelp: Open the workspace before {code}; the link works once. The session ends {ends}.
console.supportListAdmin: Every support session on the platform. Revoke an active one to end it on its next request.
console.supportListOwn: Your support sessions. Make a new link to open a workspace again, or end a session when you are done.
console.supportEmptyAdmin: Sessions started by support operators appear here.
console.supportEmptyOwn: Start one from a salon's page.
console.supportEndHelp: Access to {salon} stops on the next request. The session cannot be reopened.
console.support_session_active: You already have an open support session for this salon. End it, or open it again from Support sessions.

holidays.title: Holiday calendar
holidays.intro: Dates change by gazette every year, so the calendar is published here, never built into the app.
holidays.startYearHelp: Open a year to import or add its days. Nothing reaches salons until it is published.
holidays.emptyHelp: An Admin opens a year, imports the government calendar and publishes it to salons.
holidays.yearSummary: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {revision, plural, =0 {never published} one {revision #} other {revision #}}
holidays.importLabel: A CSV file of the year’s days
holidays.importHelp: A CSV file prepared from the official gazette, one day per line: date,name,kind (poya, public, bank or mercantile), each date in {year}. It replaces the draft’s days. Check each date before publishing.
holidays.importRefused: The file was not imported. Fix these lines and import it again:
holidays.fileMissing: Choose a CSV file to import.
holidays.imported: {days, plural, one {# day imported} other {# days imported}}. Check each date before publishing.
holidays.published: Published. Salons see “To review” under Settings.
holidays.failed: That did not work. Try again.
holidays.yearEmptyHelp: Import the government calendar, or add days one at a time.
holidays.yearEmptyRead: An Admin has not started this year.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.dateTaken: The draft has this date already.
holidays.dayRefused: Check the date, the name and the kind.
holidays.nothingToPublish: Nothing new to publish: salons already have these days.
holidays.counts: Publishing adds {added, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, changes {changed, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and withdraws {withdrawn, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
holidays.publishBody: Every salon is asked to review them. Nothing changes for a salon until it chooses what it does on each day.

billing.noPlan: No plan is assigned to this salon yet. {used, plural, one {# staff member is} other {# staff members are}} active.
billing.noSubscription: This salon has no subscription yet and is not billed.
billing.howToPay: Invoices are paid by card through the platform or by bank transfer; the platform records transfers. There is no payment entry here.
billing.invoicesEmptyHelp: The first invoice is issued when the trial ends.
billing.service_unavailable: Billing is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
billing.permission_denied: Only the salon's Owner can see its invoices.
billing.bannerTrial: The salon's free trial ends on {date}. The first monthly invoice is issued then.
billing.bannerPastDue: An invoice was due on {due} and is still unpaid. The salon becomes read-only on {readOnly} unless it is paid.
billing.bannerReadOnly: An invoice due on {due} is unpaid, so changes are paused: staff can sign in and read, but not change anything. Pay the overdue invoices by card or bank transfer to restore full access; the platform records bank transfers.

exports.title: Salon data export
exports.heading: Your salon's data export
exports.intro: This link downloads a ZIP archive of your salon's data: a JSON file per kind of record and a manifest listing them. Passwords, authenticator secrets and other credentials are never included.
exports.deleteNotice: The archive and all of the salon's data are deleted for good on {date}. Download it before then.
exports.downloaded: The archive was downloaded. Its SHA-256 checksum should match the one above.
exports.unknown: This link is not valid or has expired
exports.unknownHelp: Export links work until the salon's data is deleted. Check that you used the whole link from the email.
exports.unavailable: The download service cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
exports.noLink: Open this page from the link in your export email.

support.bannerEnds: Ends at {time}. Nothing can be changed in this view.
support.bannerReadOnly: Nothing can be changed in this view.
support.endFailed: The session could not be ended just now. Try again.
support.opened: Support view open. Loading the workspace…
support.refused: Support links work once, within a minute, on the salon they were made for. Make a new link from the operator console.
support.unavailableTitle: The workspace could not be reached

support.ended: The support view is closed. Nothing more is recorded for this session.
support.none: Support sessions are started from the operator console, which opens this page with its own link.
support.accessHelp: Platform support can read this workspace only through a time-limited session with a recorded reason. Every session and every page it opened is in the activity log. Revoke a session to end it at once.
support.accessEmptyHelp: When platform support opens your workspace, the session appears here.
support.revokeHelp: {name} will lose access to this workspace on their next request. This cannot be undone.

settings.introHours: Hours, holidays and closures save at once and apply to new bookings. Only your team sees closure reasons.

profile.published: Published. Customers now see your profile.

brand.name: Salon name

logo.label: Logo

cover.label: Cover photo
cover.rules: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image of up to 5 MB, at least 800 × 300 pixels. A wide photo works best.

imageErrors.service_unavailable: The image could not be uploaded just now. Try again in a moment.

brand.colourHelp: Six hexadecimal digits after #, like #D6086A. Text on it is made readable automatically.

brand.published: Published. Customers now see your branding.
brand.resetDone: Default branding set. Publish to show it to customers.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to 60 characters.
errors.colour: Enter a colour as # and six hexadecimal digits, like #D6086A.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.help: Customers can book inside these hours. Each professional’s own hours and breaks are under Team.
hours.closesAfterOpens: Closing time must be after opening time.
hours.outsideTitle: {count, plural, one {# upcoming booking falls} other {# upcoming bookings fall}} outside these hours.
hours.outsideBody: They are kept. Move or contact each customer yourself.

holidays.none: The operator has not published this year’s holidays yet. They appear here to review once published.
holidays.title: Public holidays {year}
holidays.published: Published by the operator on {date} from the government calendar. Choose what your salon does on each day.
holidays.allPast: This year’s holidays have all passed.

closures.help: Close for a day for training, a family event or repairs. Bookings on that day are never cancelled for you.
closures.toResolve: {count, plural, one {# booking to resolve} other {# bookings to resolve}}
closures.sheetHelp: The salon is closed all day. Customers can’t book it.
closures.dateRule: Choose today or a day up to a year ahead.
closures.impactUnavailable: The bookings on this day could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
closures.bookingsTitle: {count, plural, one {# booking on this day.} other {# bookings on this day.}}
closures.bookingsBody: They are kept: move or cancel each one yourself.

toast.holidaysAccepted: Holidays accepted. Customers can’t book on the days you close.
toast.closed: Closed. Customers can’t book this day.
toast.reopened: Reopened. Customers can book this day again.

rules.notSavedHelp: These are suggested rules. Save them, or change them first.
rules.summaryNote: Changes apply to new bookings. Existing bookings keep the policy they were made under.

rules.serviceDeposit: A service can ask for a different deposit, set on the service.
